objective_for_doctor:
Age: 2
Sex: M
Chief Complaint: jaw stiffness

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
Jaw stiffness, and I also have annoying muscle spasms in my face, neck or other parts of my body.
Have you had any recent cuts, puncture wounds, burns, or other skin injuries in the past few weeks?
Have you recently started or changed any medications, particularly anti-nausea drugs, antipsychotics, or antidepressants?
Yes—within the last 7 days I have started or taken an antipsychotic medication, and I regularly take stimulant drugs.
Are you currently experiencing a fever, excessive sweating, a rapid heartbeat, or any confusion or changes in your alertness?
Are the spasms causing your head to twist or tilt to one side, your eyes to roll upward, or any difficulty with swallowing or breathing?
Are the spasms sudden, sustained muscle contractions that cause twisting or abnormal postures and cannot be voluntarily relaxed, rather than rhythmic shaking or twitching?
[DDX] Acute dystonic reaction, Neuroleptic malignant syndrome, Stimulant-induced muscle rigidity, Tetanus, Hypocalcemia
